description: This file implements an AWS SQS logging integration for a larger system, defining the SQSLogger class that manages batching, encryption, and sending log messages to an SQS queue, as well as performing health checks.

classes.name: SQSLogger
classes.description: A batching logger that sends log entries to an AWS SQS queue, optionally with encryption, handling batching, thread-safety, and health checks.

methods.name: None __init__( self, sqs_queue_url: Optional[str] = None, sqs_region_name: Optional[str] = None, sqs_api_version: Optional[str] = None, sqs_use_ssl: bool = True, sqs_verify: Optional[bool] = None, sqs_endpoint_url: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_access_key_id: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_secret_access_key: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_session_token: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_session_name: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_profile_name: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_role_name: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_web_identity_token: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_sts_endpoint: Optional[str] = None, sqs_flush_interval: Optional[int] = DEFAULT_SQS_FLUSH_INTERVAL_SECONDS, sqs_batch_size: Optional[int] = DEFAULT_SQS_BATCH_SIZE, sqs_config=None, sqs_strip_base64_files: bool = False, sqs_aws_use_application_level_encryption: bool = False, sqs_app_encryption_key_b64: Optional[str] = None, sqs_app_encryption_aad: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the SQSLogger with configuration parameters, sets up the HTTP client, and starts the periodic flush task.

methods.name: None _init_sqs_params( self, sqs_queue_url: Optional[str] = None, sqs_region_name: Optional[str] = None, sqs_api_version: Optional[str] = None, sqs_use_ssl: bool = True, sqs_verify: Optional[bool] = None, sqs_endpoint_url: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_access_key_id: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_secret_access_key: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_session_token: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_session_name: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_profile_name: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_role_name: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_web_identity_token: Optional[str] = None, sqs_aws_sts_endpoint: Optional[str] = None, sqs_strip_base64_files: bool = False, sqs_aws_use_application_level_encryption: bool = False, sqs_app_encryption_key_b64: Optional[str] = None, sqs_app_encryption_aad: Optional[str] = None, sqs_config=None, )
methods.description: Sets up all SQS-related parameters, including credentials, endpoint, encryption options, and configuration.

methods.name: None async_log_success_event( self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time )
methods.description: Handles logging a successful event, adds the payload to the batch queue, with optional base64 stripping.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event(self, kwargs, response_obj, start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Handles logging a failure event, adds the payload to the batch queue, with optional base64 stripping.

methods.name: None async_send_batch(self)
methods.description: Sends the current batch of log messages asynchronously.

methods.name: None async_send_message(self, payload: StandardLoggingPayload)
methods.description: Sends a single log message to SQS, handling signing and optional encryption.

methods.name: IntegrationHealthCheckStatus async_health_check(self)
methods.description: Performs a health check by attempting to send a test message to the configured SQS queue.
